title: Got a lot of hate from "real" devs - anyways, my steampage is up. Let me introduce to you Azzog's Idle Asteroid
author: Baumbeard
selftext:
I am, I guess orchestrating, the development of Azzog's Idle Asteroid! The [Steam Page](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5325230/Azzogs_Idle_Asteroid/?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=launch&utm_content=r_indiegaming) is now up and running, it feels great. 

Azzog is a Desktop companion who mines, fishes and fights the occasional boss monster. He lives anywhere on your desktop and every 25 Minutes you are prompted for an important decision (mainly mining and fishing buffs).

I would be happy if you check out my steam page. and who knows, maybe azzog will accompany you during your ai game dev - sorry orchestration ;)

Greetings,  
Sebastian
